description:
Browse available paid tools, clear USD prices, and input fields. Use this first to find capability_id names; do not use for free sample runs (x402_preview_capability), service status checks (x402_check_health), or multi-item price quotes (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: leave filters blank for a compact ~5KB overview, pass lane to filter by category, or pass capability_id / include_schemas=true for full input fields and examples.
Behavior: free with no API key needed; returns one unpaginated compact list (~30 tools across categories), refreshed every 30s.

capability_id.description: Optional specific capability_id or route key to inspect (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "audio_visual_isolate", or "POST /switchboard/chunk") with its full input_schema and example_arguments.

include_schemas.description: Optional boolean; omit or false (default) for a compact ~5KB index, or pass true to embed full JSON input_schema and example_arguments for every returned capability.

lane.description: Optional capability lane filter: live_data, studio_audio, switchboard, member_tools, live_broadcast, destination_hubs, reality_clearing, culture_sports, solvers, spatial_compute, trust_privacy, audio_broadcast, finance_intel, or recipes (composite multi-agent briefs).

name: x402_list_capabilities

capabilities.description: Flat list of priced HTTP 402 capabilities including exact input_schema and example_arguments.

lanes.description: Grouped capability lanes with pricing cards.

ok.description: True when the capability catalog loaded successfully.

zero_crypto_required.description: True indicating Stripe USD prepaid settlement with zero crypto wallet required.

title: Browse Tools & Prices
